title: slice copies, splice edits
why_it_matters: One letter apart, but one is safe and one is not.
explanation: slice(start, end) returns a piece of the array and leaves the original alone; the end index isn't included. splice changes the original by removing or inserting items. Memory trick: splice is surgery on the array itself.
code:
const letters = ["a", "b", "c", "d"];
console.log(letters.slice(1, 3)); // ["b", "c"]
console.log(letters);             // unchanged
letters.splice(1, 2);             // removes "b" and "c"
console.log(letters);             // ["a", "d"]
try_it: Use slice to get the first two items of any array of five.
